lines.text: Did gladiators really fight to the death?
Two go in, one comes out. Right?
About nine times in ten, a gladiator lived to fight another day.
Each one was trained, fed and doctored, and that cost a great deal.
The last thing the school's owner wanted was a dead one.
There were rules, and a referee.
A beaten man raised a finger to give up.
And most of the time, he was spared.
So no. Most fights ended with both men walking out.
One arena doctor boasted that under his care, hardly any gladiators died.
